ATTENDANCE NOTE

Matter: boundary dispute at the rear garden

Thistlewood telephoned this morning. Thistlewood said that the fence panels had been moved

Ravensworth to review the plan and report on the boundary position.

Next step: a letter to the neighbour setting out the position on the fence.
